choice.basis: The chart title and task instructions define the vertical axis as 'Price in U.S. dollars per barrel,' overriding the conflicting 'Count' label. The y-axis is inverted, with 0 at the top and values increasing downwards to 35. The marker for the year 1980 is positioned at the lowest point on the page, corresponding to the largest numerical value on the scale (approx. 38), which represents the highest per-barrel cost in the screening cycle.
